releaseNotes: Smart Life V0.61 expands Find File Types with Audio, compressed ZIP/archive files, APK files, and an Apps storage-size summary. Audio, ZIP/archive, and APK are searchable; ZIP/archive and APK show count plus total size; Apps shows installed app package size only. The PDF shortcut icon is also replaced with a clearer PDF-style icon, and all new types use meaning-first icons.
